name: Notifications Center
description: Event notification system for Hecos. Sends notifications via MAIL or MESSENGER when system events occur (boot, errors, Flow completion, etc.). Requires at least one of the MAIL or MESSENGER plugins installed.

commands.add_destination: Adds a new notification destination (MAIL, CONTACT, or MESSENGER).
commands.remove_destination: Removes a notification destination by name.
commands.list_rules: Lists all system events and their bound destinations.
commands.bind_event_destination: Binds a destination to a system event.
commands.unbind_event_destination: Removes a destination from a system event.
commands.set_event_template: Configures an HTML template for a system event.

function.name: NOTIFICATIONS__list_destinations
function.description: Lists all configured notification destinations. Use when the user asks 'show my notification destinations', 'chi riceve le notifiche?', 'lista destinatari notifiche'.

function.name: NOTIFICATIONS__add_destination
function.description: Adds a new notification destination. Use when the user says 'add a notification destination', 'aggiungi destinatario notifica', 'send notifications to X'.

uri.description: Destination URI. Formats: MAIL:user@example.com, CONTACT:<uuid>, MESSENGER:Telegram:@username.

function.name: NOTIFICATIONS__remove_destination
function.description: Removes a notification destination by name. Use when the user says 'remove notification destination', 'rimuovi destinatario'.

name.description: The name of the destination to remove.

function.name: NOTIFICATIONS__list_rules
function.description: Lists all system events and which destinations are bound to each. Use when the user asks 'show notification rules', 'quali eventi hanno notifiche?', 'mostra regole notifiche'.

function.name: NOTIFICATIONS__bind_event_destination
function.description: Binds a destination to a system event so notifications are sent there. Use when the user says 'notify admin on system boot', 'manda notifica a X quando succede Y'.

event.description: Event type: system_boot, system_shutdown, system_error, flow_started, flow_completed, flow_failed, package_installed, package_updated, package_removed, security_login_failed, security_new_device, backup_started, backup_completed, backup_failed, custom.

destination_name.description: Name of an existing destination to bind.

function.name: NOTIFICATIONS__unbind_event_destination
function.description: Removes a destination from a system event. Use when the user says 'stop notifying X on event Y', 'rimuovi notifica per evento'.

function.name: NOTIFICATIONS__set_event_template
function.description: Configures an HTML template and its variables for a given event. Use when the user says 'set template for system boot', 'usa questo template per le notifiche'.

template_id.description: UUID of the template to use. Pass empty string to clear.

variables.description: JSON string of key-value pairs for template variables (e.g. '{"subject":"Hello","message":"World"}').

function.name: NOTIFICATIONS__send_notification
function.description: Sends an ad-hoc notification immediately. Use when the user says 'send a notification', 'manda una notifica', 'notify admin that X happened', 'avvisa che'.

destination.description: Optional destination URI (e.g. 'MAIL:user@example.com'). If omitted, sends to all configured destinations.

template_id.description: Optional template UUID to render the message with.

slash_commands.description: Manage notifications: list rules, add/remove destinations, bind events, or send ad-hoc alerts.
Send an immediate notification to all configured destinations.
